note:
R34 — dictionary text encoding and shipped-font glyph coverage per title / platform / locale (read-only).

1. Every localization dictionary (repo anchors `*eng_us.db` + the private `E:\nhl-studio-fixtures\loc\<tree>\*.db` (gen7 locales) + the
   extracted PS4 `data/kettle/loc/*.db`) is decoded string by string (Huffman tree + pool, the 2026-09-18 `tdb.py` readers); the byte
   alphabet is classified: ASCII only / valid UTF-8 multibyte sequences (and how many) / isolated high bytes (single-byte code page).
   The code points used (UTF-8 decoded where valid, else the bytes as Latin-1 candidates) are collected per file.
2. The shipped TrueType fonts of the matching tree (gen7 `fe/ion/fonts/*.ttf` + `fonts.txt`; PS4 `nhl/data/common/font/*.ttf`,
   `nhl/data/common/font/webkitfont/*.ttf`, `nhl/ui/fonts/*.ttf`) are read: `cmap` subtables (formats 4 and 12, Unicode platforms) ->
   the set of code points each font maps. Coverage = code points used by a locale's texts that no shipped font (and each font) maps.
Nothing about which font a given screen uses is claimed (`fonts.txt` order is recorded; `arial.ttf` is listed but not shipped on gen7).
Usage: python r34_font_glyph_coverage.py <out.json> [--only anchors|private|ps4]
